features.label: Elongated, simplified forms
features.explanation: Simplify existing forms into elegant, continuous long curves and coherent color fields
features.evidence: The figure’s arms, shoulders, neck and hem are simplified into continuous, sweeping curves.
features.zh: 将原有形体概括为优雅、连贯的长曲线与完整色面
features.en: Simplify existing forms into elegant, continuous long curves and coherent color fields

features.label: Flowing contours
features.explanation: Outline the subjects with clear curves of rhythmically varied thickness, letting the lines turn naturally with the forms
features.evidence: The outer contours are clearly defined, while the internal folds and patterns use finer lines.
features.zh: 以粗细有节奏的清楚曲线勾勒主体，线条随形体自然转折
features.en: Outline the subjects with clear curves of rhythmically varied thickness, letting the lines turn naturally with the forms

features.label: Soft decorative colors
features.explanation: Use ivory, muted olive green and soft warm reds, keeping the large color fields orderly
features.evidence: Ivory clothing, olive-green lines and fields, and warm red flowers create a softly printed color relationship.
features.zh: 采用米白、低饱和橄榄绿和柔和暖红，保持大色面的秩序
features.en: Use ivory, muted olive green and soft warm reds, keeping the large color fields orderly

features.label: Reduced shading
features.explanation: Reduce naturalistic shading so contours and color fields become the main visual clues
features.evidence: The body retains some shading, but the image is read mainly through lines and color fields.
features.zh: 降低写实明暗，让轮廓与色块成为主要识别线索
features.en: Reduce naturalistic shading so contours and color fields become the main visual clues

features.label: Flat visual order
features.explanation: Keep the original viewpoint and arrange existing forms in a flat rhythm of orderly dense and open areas
features.evidence: The floral disk and figure form nested layers, with large light-colored areas beside dense patterns.
features.zh: 保持原视角，将原有形体组织成疏密有序的平面节奏
features.en: Keep the original viewpoint and arrange existing forms in a flat rhythm of orderly dense and open areas

features.label: Print-like surface
features.explanation: Use matte color fields and fine lines, retaining subtle hand-drawn variation
features.evidence: Fine printed lines coexist with even color fields, without the appearance of thick paint buildup.
features.zh: 使用哑光色面与精细线条，保留轻微手绘起伏
features.en: Use matte color fields and fine lines, retaining subtle hand-drawn variation

features.label: Elegance and ornament
features.explanation: Create an elegant, gentle atmosphere with decorative order
features.evidence: Sweeping lines and orderly ornament together create an idealized, elegant character.
features.zh: 营造优雅、舒缓、富有装饰秩序的氛围
features.en: Create an elegant, gentle atmosphere with decorative order

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
